title: Winter Jam
seo_title: Winter Jam 2027 at Great Southern Bank Arena, Springfield
description: Winter Jam 2027 is a night of Christian music and worship featuring Crowder, Anne Wilson, Andy Mineo ft. Magic & Bird, Strings & Heart, Terrian, Red, and NewSong, with a message from speaker Zane Black. A Pre-Jam Party with Natural State, CJ Emulous, and Mary-Clair takes place before the show. It happens Friday, February 19, 2027 at 7:00 PM at Great Southern Bank Arena in Springfield, MO, with doors opening at 6:00 PM and a $15 donation at the door.
